units: Hz, Nm, N/mm, W, ms unless noted. Original casing of titles is preserved. Keys use lowercase DOI, normalized archive IDs for theses, and a separate arXiv alias. Non-DOI conference papers use the identifier printed in the proceedings. A preprint-specific DOI with no confirmed journal alias is marked explicitly.
comparisons: comparisons.csv contains only arithmetic derived from a paper's rounded published scalar values. No sample-level input/output streams are included. All ratios are within-paper. Computed comparisons are not pooled estimates.
publish_scope: Bibliographic metadata, original descriptions, reference pointers and calculated quantities only. Source paper PDFs, figure images, participant files and repository archives are not redistributed here.

unresolved_gap: The collection includes physical saturation observations, separate load-side sensing and model/fixture-derived references. No study here establishes an unrestricted file containing synchronous unclipped demand, applied limited command, and independently measured joint shaft torque during saturation.
